name: ICAO Digital Travel Credential
description: Draft MIP mapping for the ICAO Digital Travel Credential virtual component and its PKI trust model. This profile does not map ICAO DTC to ISO mDoc or prescribe OID4VCI delivery.
specification_reference: ICAO TR Digital Travel Credentials (DTC): Virtual Component Data Structure and PKI Mechanisms v1.2 (October 2020); ICAO TR Digital Travel Credentials (DTC): Physical Component and Protocols v1.1 (October 2022)

required_claims.name: dtcData.dtcDG1
required_claims.description: Data Group 1 encoded as defined by ICAO Doc 9303 Part 10

required_claims.name: dtcData.dtcDG2
required_claims.description: Data Group 2 encoded as defined by ICAO Doc 9303 Part 10

required_claims.name: dtcData.dtcSOD
required_claims.description: Document Security Object; required for eMRTD-bound and eMRTD-PC-bound DTCs and prohibited for PC-bound DTCs

required_claims.name: dtcTBS
required_claims.description: To-be-signed hash values; required for eMRTD-PC-bound and PC-bound DTCs and prohibited for eMRTD-bound DTCs

required_claims.name: dtcSignerInfo
required_claims.description: DTC Signer certificate and signature information; required for eMRTD-PC-bound and PC-bound DTCs and prohibited for eMRTD-bound DTCs
